run_train_model: run fairseq training on one or multiple GPUs using cli_main with config args
run_validate_model: run validation on a subset by calling validate with trainer and task config
run_early_stopping: run early stopping check using should_stop_early with validation loss and patience config
run_train_epoch: run one epoch of training using train function with trainer task and epoch iterator
run_save_checkpoint: run checkpoint saving via validate_and_save which handles validation and checkpoint logic
